answer: Identities join a cohort of ten and each posts an 85 bond into the lagoon pool, sealed by an opal receipt in the grove registry. Each epoch, grove auditors audit a random third of cohorts, checking members' work; a cohort with a fake member burns all ten opal bonds and drops the cohort. First and thousandth fakes each cost 85, so 1,000 fakes lock 85,000 in the lagoon pool with no batch discount, and a fake cannot hide in a real cohort since its work fails that audit. A fake-only cohort fails: mutual vouches do not pass the grove work audit. An honest agent posts 85 once and joins nine peers.
